head: 567106cc0fff5a952bc3873a17e3ac58f3f1b408
summary: Round 1 findings are resolved. The blocker is cleared: test-summary.json is pass, clean, 86/86 on 567106c. The only later commit (2c9ebd5) touches .agents/ only, and the tree is clean outside .agents. The major is fixed: the Lua script takes a per-messageId SET NX marker before INCR, and RedisVelocityCounterIT#sameMessageIsCountedOnce covers it. The minor is fixed: RedisVelocityCounterUnavailableTest covers B2 against an unreachable Redis. CI checks for HEAD are empty (e2e absent), and the PR validates them.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: AssessRiskIT#fourthTransferInTheWindowIsRejected runs real Kafka and Redis. The fourth transfer in the window gets a VELOCITY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED rejection. VelocityRuleTest covers the boundary.

The Lua script is atomic: SET NX marker, INCR, then PEXPIRE on the first hit. The inbox check precedes the counter. Tests: concurrentIncrementsAreAtomic, sameMessageIsCountedOnce, AssessRiskIT#redeliveryDoesNotCountTwice.

An unreachable Redis makes the counter throw (RedisVelocityCounterUnavailableTest). The exception rolls back the use-case transaction and the message is retried (AssessRiskServiceTest#counterFailureNeverApproves).

findings.description: The class Javadoc has one overlong, badly wrapped line. The VelocityCounter Javadoc has the same problem. Spotless passes, so this is cosmetic.
